footnotes: The data provider reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow. Operating income follows StockAnalysis, which places unusual items below the operating line: −$7.3M asset writedowns, $1.3M gains/losses on investments in 2025; $3.8M gains/losses on investments in 2024 (signs as reported: negative = charge).

Figures are from StockAnalysis (S&P Global Market Intelligence data) for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier; free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items not reported there are left out.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Black Diamond, a clinical-stage oncology company, focuses on the discovery and development of MasterKey therapies for patients with genetically defined tumors. Revenue was $70.0M in 2025, versus $0 a year earlier. Operating income was $19.9M, up from a $78.8M loss.
Net income was $22.4M, or $0.39 per share, after a $69.7M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $29.6M and free cash flow $29.6M, versus −$62.3M; Black Diamond returned $146K through buybacks.
